newsitem.title: USA: McDonnell Douglas aerospace head quits.
newsitem.headline: McDonnell Douglas aerospace head quits.

text.p: McDonnell Douglas Corp said on Friday that Herbert Lanese, who served as president of the McDonnell Douglas Aerospace unit, has left the company.
Until a successor is named, the company's aerospace military components will report directly to Harry Stonecipher, corporate president and chief executive.

"Although Herb and I were in total agreement regading business objectives and strategy, we had sharp working differences involving management and leadership styles," said Stonecipher in a statement. "After two years of working together, it became obvious to me that these differences could not be reconciled. We all wish him well."
Lanese was named deputy president of McDonnell Douglas Aerospace on July 24, 1995. Prior to that he was chief financial officer.
